actual_scope: Actual single LLM/harness transition after explicit typed pre-turn state bootstrap. Not a new whole natural conversation.

actual_failure.raw_model_output: Seven operations preserve the second hotel/party/budget/rooms/dates, but no first-stay hotel assignment despite a positive keep wish.
actual_failure.bounded_interpretation: The literal preservation wish was not persisted as a hotel identity constraint. A null pin does not by itself prove that a displayed hotel or price switched.
actual_failure.selected_hotel_id_in_actual_quote: Not separately persisted in the operator files; fresh PG preview identities are tested independently.

action.authority: Positive current keep-hotel instruction with owned ordinal stay or unique city; fresh code-owned current UI-preview selection re-read through Store after model extraction.
action.effect: Append only replace_hotel for an unpinned explicitly preserved stay; same already-extracted assignment is not duplicated. An existing persisted pin needs no fresh quote.
action.no_context: Before pin null with no valid fresh selection asks the user to select an actual current variant. No first-shown-plan default is used.
action.conflicts: Same-stay replace/keep, a different extracted hotel assignment, city/topology/provider changes produce clarification/conflict rather than guessed identity.

root_integration.fresh_lookup: After model response, not the prompt context copy.
root_integration.classification: A proved code-owned positive pin may set CHANGE; model ASK classification cannot erase the literal keep wish.

related_geo_refinement.change: The same proved existing hotel/room/condition reference role clears only destination facts before target resolution, covering single-city as well as multi-city component mentions. Raw operations and other facts are unchanged.
negative_boundaries: new stay or changed city/origin/route policy

asserted: actual fresh third-plan preview identity differs from first shown
the exact captured seven-op WOW batch gains the omitted selected first-hotel pin
original source breakfast/room/party/budget/second-hotel/date facts remain correct and OPTIONS_READY
old quote confirmation409 and no orders
missing selection asks rather than defaults
model ASK/none cannot suppress an explicit code-owned keep
existing canonical pin survives keep without a fresh quote
pg_scope.third_plan_fixture_boundary: The actual mandatory-breakfast prestate admits only two plans. The dedicated third-plan identity case explicitly removes that constraint in a separate fixture to obtain a real plan3; it does not relabel plan2. The exact WOW case retains the original breakfast constraint.

test_precondition_change: The former city-scope cached-flow test now performs an explicit preview before asking to keep an unpinned first hotel. Without that preview the new intended response is clarification. Historical no-preview PASS evidence is preserved rather than regraded.
hash_scope: E working-tree bytes, not the installed native source identity.
closure: Repeat the actual typed-prestate single NLU transition on a new immutable deployed source with a real selected preview. Require the selected first-hotel ID to persist alongside every previous WOW state and ready-plan predicate; do not call it a fresh full conversation.
